notes: RCM LOINC crosswalk views. Both author queries kept verbatim: (1) rcm_lab_loinc left-joins the codebucket's LOINC-typed rows to OMOP CONCEPT on concept_code; (2) rcm_lab_loinc_group nests an inner join of CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP 'Subsumes' edges with the 'LOINC Group' CONCEPT subselect, then joins back to CONCEPT for the member LOINC. Mocked dat.vdw_codebucket (LOINC rows), vocab.concept (LOINC lab + LOINC Group concepts), vocab.concept_relationship (Subsumes edges). Two-level dat./vocab. mapped to work tables in autoexec.
